title: Install the main ruleset requiring v4-required and reach G2_V4_AUTONOMOUS (V4-TODO-011 phase 2)
goal: Complete 03 section 6 items 6-8 for Guard: install a reviewed branch ruleset on main that requires the exact v4-required context from GitHub Actions with strict up-to-date checking, merge-only PRs and an admin-only PR bypass, require approval for external fork workflow runs, and prove it with negative and positive control pull requests.
acceptanceCriteria: The ruleset returned by the API equals the reviewed specimen docs/plans/activation/guard-main-ruleset.json: v4-required from integration 15368, strict policy, pull_request with merge only, deletion and non_fast_forward, admin bypass in pull_request mode.
The Actions fork pull request approval policy is all_external_contributors.
A negative-control PR fails v4-required and a non-admin merge attempt is refused with mergeStateStatus BLOCKED; it is closed unmerged.
A positive-control records PR is green and CLEAN and merges without bypass.
Records declare G2_V4_AUTONOMOUS, complete V4-TODO-011, add the O19 bypass rule and a code-owner review follow-up, with no tag, release, workflow or product change.
risks: A single maintainer cannot satisfy required approving reviews; review of .github and authorization records is realized through CI scope, sole-writer merges, the logged admin bypass and fork-run approval.
PRs outside the workflow paths filter receive no v4-required and need the bypass.
An overly broad bypass would weaken the gate; bypass is limited to admin, pull_request mode and the O19 conditions.
decisions: Only the aggregate v4-required context is required, pinned to the GitHub Actions app (integration 15368).
Strict up-to-date checking makes the judged base equal current main.
Merge commits only; zero required approvals; admin bypass only via pull requests.
The ruleset is applied from a reviewed specimen stored under docs/plans/activation.
